card.name: Inside brand drug names in capitals
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of brand drug names written in capitals, such as NERLYNX, BYETTA, CYRAMZA, VISUDYNE and ALECENSA. It fires on the piece just before the final ending, in dosing and warning sections.

modes.label: Brand name middle
modes.description: A middle piece of an all-caps brand name, when the name is mentioned in a dosing or warning sentence.
modes.example: Resume CY<<RAM>>ZA at a reduced dose: Reduce

modes.label: Capitalized instruction word
modes.description: A split capitalized warning word in handling instructions.

card.writes: It seems to push toward the next piece of an unfinished capitalized name, such as a short all-caps ending.
card.plain: It marks the middle of a capitalized brand drug name, where the rest of the name is still to come.
